widget.name: FormStudio Builder (Next)
widget.description: Next-gen redesign of RjsfFormBuilder. Form.io-style JSON form designer, viewer, document-output builder, and PDF-ready renderer powered by RJSF.

property.caption: Viewer header widget
property.description: Optional Mendix widget rendered in viewer mode before the Save button.

property.caption: Form context
property.description: Single-object datasource that stores form definition and values.

property.caption: Form definition JSON
property.description: String/LongString attribute that stores the builder definition JSON.

property.caption: Form title
property.description: Optional attribute to store the current form title.

property.caption: Form description
property.description: Optional attribute to store the current form description.

property.caption: Token context JSON
property.description: Optional String/LongString JSON object of runtime token values (key/value pairs) used when resolving document output templates.

property.caption: Snippets JSON
property.description: Optional String/LongString JSON array of canned-text snippets ([{id,name,text,scope}]) offered on text/textarea fields in viewer fill mode. Empty or invalid JSON disables the feature.

property.caption: Token catalog schema JSON
property.description: Optional String/LongString JSON schema/catalog used only by the builder token picker (Client Data). This defines available token keys and labels, but does not provide runtime values.

property.caption: System templates config JSON
property.description: Optional String/LongString JSON array of extra system template definitions ({type,label,keyBase?,slotProperty?,rowIdKey?,documentOutputTemplate?,columns:[{key,label,type?,required?,columnSpan?,options?}]}). They appear in the designer toolbox next to the built-in templates; at runtime their slot renders HTML supplied via the system section HTML JSON keyed by slotProperty.

property.caption: Resolved output HTML
property.description: Optional String/LongString attribute to store rendered token-replaced output on save.

property.caption: Resolved PDF HTML
property.description: Optional String/LongString attribute to store full print-ready HTML for server-side PDF conversion.

property.caption: System section HTML JSON
property.description: Optional String/LongString JSON object keyed by system template slot property. Each value should contain print-ready HTML to inject into the PDF output for that system section.

property.caption: Form data JSON
property.description: Optional String/LongString attribute to store form values.

property.caption: Derived schema JSON
property.description: Optional attribute to store generated JSON Schema.

property.caption: Derived uiSchema JSON
property.description: Optional attribute to store generated RJSF uiSchema.

property.caption: Field count
property.description: Output attribute: total number of fields in the form. Updated live.

property.caption: Required field count
property.description: Output attribute: number of required fields. Updated live.

property.caption: Section count
property.description: Output attribute: number of distinct sections. Updated live.

property.caption: Completion percent
property.description: Output attribute: percentage (0–100) of trackable fields that have a value. Updated live.

property.caption: On change
property.description: Runs when definition or form data changes.

property.caption: On save
property.description: Runs when Save button is clicked.

property.caption: On export PDF
property.description: Runs when the viewer Export PDF button is clicked after refreshed HTML output has been written.

property.caption: On manage snippets
property.description: Optional action invoked by the Manage library link in the snippets popover. When unset the link is hidden.

property.caption: Publish field key
property.description: Output attribute: receives the field key when the designer's "Publish as shared field" button is clicked, just before On publish field runs.

property.caption: On publish field
property.description: Runs after Publish field key is written; wire to a microflow that registers the field as a shared token. When unset the designer button is hidden.

property.caption: Token context datasource
property.description: Optional runtime datasource returning token key/value rows. Used to resolve token values in document output templates.

property.caption: Token key attribute
property.description: Attribute containing runtime token key names (for example: ClientFirstName, ClientDOB).

property.caption: Token value attribute
property.description: Attribute containing runtime token values for each key row.

property.caption: View mode
property.description: Designer for building forms, Viewer for end-user form entry.

property.caption: Show palette panel
property.description: Show/hide the field palette. Defaults to true.

property.caption: Show components panel
property.description: Show/hide the designer component list. In viewer mode this enables the left navigation panel, which can host section progress chips when the section panel is also enabled. Defaults to true.

property.caption: Show section panel
property.description: Show/hide section navigation shortcuts. In viewer mode these render as section progress chips in the left navigation panel. Defaults to true.

property.caption: Show properties panel
property.description: Show/hide component property editor. Defaults to true.

property.caption: Show preview panel
property.description: Show/hide live RJSF preview. Defaults to true.

property.caption: Show layout tools
property.description: Show/hide layout templates in the palette. Defaults to true.

property.caption: Show viewer header
property.description: Show/hide the viewer header row that contains the form title, optional header widget, and save/export actions. Defaults to true.

property.caption: Show document preview
property.description: Viewer only: when this expression is true, render the resolved document output (narrative) instead of the fill form.

property.caption: Preview flow
property.description: Viewer only: how the document preview renders. Cards keeps the bordered per-section card. Continuous strips the card chrome and adds a large typographic section heading so consecutive section widgets read as one flowed document.

property.caption: Active Medications Datagrid2
property.description: Mendix widget for Active Medications system template placeholder.

property.caption: Active Allergies Datagrid2
property.description: Mendix widget for Active Allergies system template placeholder.

property.caption: Chart Diagnosis Datagrid2
property.description: Mendix widget for Chart Diagnosis system template placeholder.

property.caption: Billing Diagnosis Datagrid2
property.description: Mendix widget for Billing Diagnosis system template placeholder.

property.caption: Active Billing Codes Datagrid2
property.description: Mendix widget for Active Billing Codes system template placeholder.

property.caption: Most Recent Drug Test Datagrid2
property.description: Mendix widget for Most Recent Drug Test system template placeholder.

property.caption: Viewer theme preset
property.description: Visual preset for end-user form entry mode.

property.caption: Live validate
property.description: Enable live validation while users type. Defaults to false.

property.caption: Save button text
property.description: Custom text for Save action button.

property.caption: Export PDF button text
property.description: Custom text for the viewer Export PDF action button.
